def build(ctx):
    a = ctx.alloc(3)
    ctx.reg("a", a)
    b = ctx.alloc(3)
    ctx.reg("b", b)
    
    # Temporary qubits for carry chain
    c = [ctx.alloc() for _ in range(3)]
    
    # Compute carries using Toffoli gates
    # c[0] = a[0] & b[0]
    ctx.ccx(a[0], b[0], c[0])
    # c[1] = (a[1] & b[1]) ^ (a[1] & c[0]) ^ (b[1] & c[0])
    ctx.ccx(a[1], b[1], c[1])
    ctx.ccx(a[1], c[0], c[1])
    ctx.ccx(b[1], c[0], c[1])
    # c[2] = (a[2] & b[2]) ^ (a[2] & c[1]) ^ (b[2] & c[1])
    ctx.ccx(a[2], b[2], c[2])
    ctx.ccx(a[2], c[1], c[2])
    ctx.ccx(b[2], c[1], c[2])
    
    # Sum bits: s[i] = a[i] ^ b[i] ^ c[i-1] (with c[-1]=0)
    # s[0] = a[0] ^ b[0]
    ctx.cx(a[0], b[0])
    # s[1] = a[1] ^ b[1] ^ c[0]
    ctx.cx(a[1], b[1])
    ctx.cx(c[0], b[1])
    # s[2] = a[2] ^ b[2] ^ c[1]
    ctx.cx(a[2], b[2])
    ctx.cx(c[1], b[2])
    
    # Now b holds the sum. Need to transform a to hold the sum as well.
    # We'll copy b to a using CNOTs (since b is now sum)
    ctx.cx(b[0], a[0])
    ctx.cx(b[1], a[1])
    ctx.cx(b[2], a[2])
    
    # Clean up: uncompute carries
    ctx.ccx(b[2], c[1], c[2])
    ctx.ccx(a[2], c[1], c[2])
    ctx.ccx(a[2], b[2], c[2])
    ctx.ccx(b[1], c[0], c[1])
    ctx.ccx(a[1], c[0], c[1])
    ctx.ccx(a[1], b[1], c[1])
    ctx.ccx(a[0], b[0], c[0])

    b = ctx.alloc(3); ctx.reg("b", b)
    c = ctx.alloc()                 # single carry ancilla, |0>

    def maj(i):
        # (a[i], b[i], c) -> (a^b, b^c, carry_out)
        ctx.cx(b[i], a[i])
        ctx.cx(c, b[i])
        ctx.ccx(a[i], b[i], c)
        ctx.cx(b[i], c)

    def uma(i):
        # (a^b, b^c, carry_out) -> (sum, b, carry_in)
        ctx.ccx(a[i], b[i], c)
        ctx.cx(b[i], c)
        ctx.cx(c, b[i])
        ctx.cx(c, a[i])

    for i in range(3):           # forward: propagate carries LSB->MSB
        maj(i)
    for i in range(3 - 1, -1, -1):   # backward: uncompute carries MSB->LSB
        uma(i)

    ctx.free(c)
